title: WELCOME TO BOREAS — SURFACE OPERATIONS
body:
You are the night operator of Surface Station 3, the
monitoring terminal for Facility Boreas.

Your duties: route power allocations, log environmental
readings, and answer comms requests from the on-site team.
The on-site team works Sub-Level 4. You do not.

If automated systems and on-site staff disagree, trust the
automated systems. That is what they are for.

Shift change arrives at 06:00. Until then, the facility
is yours.
